term_of_protection: Author's life + 60 years (anonymous & pseudonymous works: 60 years from publication; audiovisual works & software: 60 years from first publication)
digital_protection: Unauthorised circumvention of TPMs treated as a computer crime (Special Law on Computer Crimes 2001), per Lipszyc; no TPM article found in the copyright law
enforcement_body: Servicio Autónomo de la Propiedad Intelectual (SAPI)
